nodes.description: EIP-1967 implementation storage slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc holding the delegatecall target address.
EIP-1967 admin/owner storage slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103 holding the privileged owner address.
receive() external payable that forwards all plain ETH transfers to _fallback().
fallback() external payable that forwards all unknown calldata to _fallback().
_fallback() internal: loads implementation slot via sload, calldatacopy and delegatecall(gas(), implementation, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0), then copies and returns/reverts returndata.

_setImplementation(address,bytes) internal: reads previous implementation via sload, sstore's the new implementation, emits ProxyImplementationUpdated, optionally delegatecalls provided data and bubbles up revert data.
constructor(address implementationAddress, bytes data, address ownerAddress) of EIP173Proxy: calls _setImplementation then _setOwner.
owner() external view returning _owner().
supportsInterface(bytes4) external view: returns fixed values for known interface ids, otherwise sloads the implementation and try/catch-delegate-forward the ERC165 call.
transferOwnership(address) external onlyOwner that calls _setOwner(newOwner).
changeImplementation(address,bytes) external onlyOwner that calls _setImplementation(newImplementation, data).
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == _owner(), "NOT_AUTHORIZED") - the sole access-control gate for privileged proxy operations.
_owner() internal view: sloads the admin slot 0xb531...6103 into adminAddress.
_setOwner(address) internal: reads previous owner, sstore's newOwner into the admin slot and emits OwnershipTransferred.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used in the onlyOwner access-control check.
delegatecall(gas(), implementationAddress, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside _fallback: executes arbitrary attacker-supplied calldata in proxy storage context.

newImplementation.delegatecall(data) inside _setImplementation: owner-supplied (or constructor) call executed in proxy storage context, enabling reentrancy and storage tampering before/after the sstore.
assembly sstore of the implementation slot 0x3608...2bbc with newImplementation.
assembly sstore of the admin/owner slot 0xb531...6103 with newOwner.
newImplementation parameter of _setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes memory data).
data parameter of _setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes memory data) - delegatecall payload.
implementationAddress constructor parameter of EIP173Proxy.
ownerAddress constructor parameter of EIP173Proxy.
id (bytes4) parameter of supportsInterface.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
newImplementation parameter of changeImplementation.
data (bytes calldata) parameter of changeImplementation, forwarded to the delegatecall in _setImplementation.
newOwner parameter of _setOwner.
previousImplementation local in _setImplementation, read from the implementation slot before overwriting.
success local in _fallback capturing the delegatecall result.
retSz local in _fallback holding returndatasize().
ERC165 implementation local in supportsInterface loaded from the implementation slot.
support local in supportsInterface holding the try/catch delegate result.
previousOwner local in _setOwner read before overwriting the owner slot.
adminAddress local in _owner() returned from the sload of the admin slot.
success local returned by the delegatecall in _setImplementation.

edges.reason: receive() forwards to _fallback().
fallback() forwards to _fallback().

_fallback uses returndatasize() for returndatacopy and revert/return sizes.

constructor calls _setOwner(ownerAddress).

changeImplementation is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner.
onlyOwner reads the stored owner through _owner() for the authorization check.
msg.sender is the externally supplied principal being validated against _owner().

transferOwnership routes to _setOwner.

constructor ownerAddress flows into _setOwner.
changeImplementation newImplementation flows into _setImplementation.

_setImplementation consumes its data parameter.

_setOwner writes the owner slot via sstore.
newOwner parameter is written into the owner storage slot.

_owner() sloads the admin/owner slot.
_owner() returns the sloaded value as adminAddress.
owner() external view delegates to _owner().

normalization_plan.reason: newImplementation is the argument bound directly by _setImplementation and is written to the implementation slot.
data is the payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation inside _setImplementation.
constructor's implementationAddress is only used as the _setImplementation argument.
constructor's ownerAddress is only used as the _setOwner argument.
id is only used inside supportsInterface for the ERC165 interface-id comparisons.
transferOwnership's newOwner is only used as the _setOwner argument.
changeImplementation's newImplementation is forwarded straight to _setImplementation.
calldata is forwarded into the delegatecall payload of _setImplementation.
newOwner is the value sstore'd into the owner slot by _setOwner.
previousImplementation is a temporary holding the sload of the implementation slot inside _setImplementation.
success only captures the _fallback delegatecall result for the switch.
retSz only holds the returndatasize used by _fallback's return/revert.
implementation is a transient handle to the implementation slot used by supportsInterface.
support only holds the try/catch result returned by supportsInterface.
previousOwner is a temporary holding the prior owner read inside _setOwner.
adminAddress is the return value of the sload performed in _owner().
success only captures the delegatecall result inside _setImplementation.
